translations.web: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.
translations.bsb: Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered.
translations.kjv: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
translations.asv: And they that are wise among the people shall instruct many; yet they shall fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by spoil, many days.
